confidences.reason: The log shows that by Step 10 the agent had accessed a stats page (reporting 2,812 total edits) and was instructed to find a way to filter to June 2023. In Step 11, instead of using Wikipedia/XTools filtering or the revision history to get an exact count up to June 2023, the agent assumed an inception year (2001) and a uniform edit rate to produce an approximate figure (2,619) without verification or sourcing. This deviates from the plan and constitutes a methodological error.

Up to step 10, the agent was correctly navigating to obtain exact figures (revision history/XTools) and even noted the need to filter to June 2023. At step 11, it abandoned retrieving exact stats and instead introduced an average-based estimate, which directly caused the incorrect outcome. No earlier step reflects a methodological error leading to the wrong answer.

After Step 11 provided an approximation instead of using tools to get the exact count, Steps 12–13 accepted and finalized that estimate without further tool queries or corrections. No subsequent step revisited the data to obtain the precise June 2023 edit count.
Step 11 exists in the log and its agent is 'WebSurfer'.
